Class Tribe

java.lang.Object
mesos.tribe.Tribe
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Tribe extends Object implements Serializable
One player's collection of acquired characters and buildings. Owns the mutable lists; character-side math is delegated to CharacterStats and building-side aggregation to BuildingEffects.
